combinedEightThreadProof.admission: Both enterCurrent and binding admission use the SAME existing gate. Compute current union cardinality; if current Thread is absent from BOTH sets and size(U)>=8, decline diagnostic admission. If already in either set, adding membership to the other set does not increase cardinality. No replacement binding for an active Thread.
combinedEightThreadProof.induction: Initially U empty. The only two admissions can add at most one absent identity and are guarded under one monitor; every removal only shrinks U. Therefore size(U)<=8 throughout, not two independent eight-entry caps.
